comment: P4-35/36/37 generator switch for tools/blender/assets.json 'creatures' (proposal; apply by hand). Existing ids keep their sizes. Entries under 'new' are NEW model ids (no enemy uses them yet): free parts for future HandBrain / part data, and shielded pillar variants for a ModelOverride swap while NpcSystem.ShieldUp is true (the renderer has no per-part shield toggle). The new generators use the fur/bone texture layers (present in the main checkout's layers.json).

pumpking_blade.note: One clawed hand with its scythe, centred on the grip, blade edge toward +Y. For future pumpking parts [pumpking_blade x2] with the HandBrain 'swipe' style; when those parts exist, set pumpking's params to {"hands": false}.

saucer_turret.note: Optional: one of the saucer's four under-hull turrets, mounted at the origin, barrels toward +Y (future parts).

dutchman_cannon.note: Optional: a carriage cannon, trunnions at the origin, barrel toward +Y (future parts).

solar_pillar_shielded.note: Optional: the pillar inside its translucent shield shell (prop:gel:clear), for a model swap while the shield is up.
